content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NHAI Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHAI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application for NHAI Recruitment 2026 is 21 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by NHAI?
faq.answer: NHAI has announced a total of 60 vacancies for the posts of Deputy General Manager (Technical) and Manager (Technical) in the latest recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Institute, along with relevant work experience as specified for each post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to NHAI posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 56 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for NHAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Deputy General Manager (Technical) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Deputy General Manager (Technical) post is Level-12 in the Pay Matrix, which ranges from Rs. 78,800 to Rs. 2,09,200 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Manager (Technical) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Manager (Technical) post is Level-11 in the Pay Matrix, which ranges from Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700 per month.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the NHAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of NHAI or via the direct application link provided in the 'Important Links' section before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for NHAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves screening of applications, followed by a written test or interview, document verification, and a final selection by a committee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF for NHAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section on this page or directly from the NHAI official website.
